C. 1949
NOTES from SCRIPTURE, etc. - DEUTERONOMY
VIII Grateful appreciation stressed again & again. 20 ... As the nations which the Lord destroyed at thy Entrance, so shall you also perish, if you be disobedient to the voice of the Lord your God."
X - 6 ... And. .. Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar succeeded him in the priestly office. 22 - In 70 souls went down into Egypt.
XII - 2 Destroy all the places in which the nations you shall po- ssess, worshiped their gods upon high mountains and hills and under every shady tree.
XXII - 5 A woman shall not be clothed with man's apparel, neither shall a man use woman's apparel; for he that doth these things is abomin- able before God.
XXVII - 16 Cursed be he that honorath not his father and mother; and all the people shall say, Amen.
Easter Sunday 4 - 17 - '49
To-day: Dear Father Stephen, I turn to you for help with our million- dollar proposition. I've been trying for months - if not a year and more and still have not even an -
STATUE UNVEILED 4 - 27 - "49
May 3rd Drive to Milwaukee. Pleasant Surprise in Chicago - unexpected dinner prepared at O'Ds.
May 4th Unveiling of Statue - Fr. Steph's
Thanks be to God - -Blessing of Rev. Mother M. Didelis at Notre Dame Convent in - ptomane-poison, ambulanced to Hospital - delayed till Friday in same"
In St. Joseph Hospital May 13 - 22 Sundays but not 2 weeks. Hard to believe! First two days seemed like weeks !!..... Experience quite worth while. Deo Gratias .... no sleep ....
END of NOTES from SCRIPTURE, etc.
